editorial:
You know that feeling when a movie drops two strangers into the worst possible situation and makes you root for them? That is exactly what happens here. After a charter plane crashes in the snowy mountains, a doctor and a photojournalist are left alone with almost no supplies. They have to trust each other fast, even though they barely know each other. The cold, the hunger, and the long walks across frozen ground make every step feel risky. It is a survival story, but it is also about two people slowly opening up. The scenery is huge and beautiful, which makes the danger feel even bigger.

Idris Elba and Kate Winslet carry the whole movie, and their chemistry keeps you watching even when the plot slows down. The action scenes are tense, and the quiet moments give you time to breathe. On the downside, some parts feel a little too neat, and the romance can feel rushed. Still, if you like survival dramas with heart, this is a good pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Ben and Alex finally make it to safety after weeks in the wilderness. They are rescued and taken to a hospital. At first, they go back to their old lives and lose touch. Alex later learns Ben has lost his sight in one eye from the crash. She tracks him down, and they reunite at his apartment. They embrace, choosing to be together instead of letting fear keep them apart. The movie ends on a hopeful note, showing that their bond survived the mountain.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival stories with romance.
